a.text: Valladolid was re-established by King Alfonso VI of Castile as a Lordship for the Count Pedro Ansúrez.

b.text: Alfonso VI of León and Castile gifted the Lordship of Valladolid to Count Pedro Ansúrez.

a.text: Valladolid was endowed with a University.

b.text: The University of Valladolid was founded by Alfonso VIII of Castille.

a.text: Valladolid became briefly the capital of Habsburg Spain under Phillip III.

b.text: Valladolid briefly served as the capital of the Hispanic Monarchy.

a.text: Valladolid ceased to be the capital, returning indefinitely to Madrid.

b.text: Valladolid ceased to serve as the capital of the Hispanic Monarchy.

a.text: Valladolid was designated as the de jure seat of the executive and legislative institutions.
22 013 people were employed in industrial workplaces.
The Madrid–Valladolid high-speed rail line was inaugurated.
